title: Priya's compliance ticker - SOC2 & vendor todo
content:
Quick morning dump — priority list

Top priorities (today)
- Finish vendor evidence checklist for Okta/Identity (need MFA config screenshots + contract clause)
- Upload SRE retention policy snapshot to evidence repo (log-retention-2026-03-14.tar)
- Draft memo for legal: third-party subprocessors update (short, one page)

SOC2 evidence checklist (working)
- Access reviews: central admin list (need exports from Okta - Raj to run, SEC-4321)
- MFA proof: screenshot + timestamped event log (pending: SRE to provide login audit)
- Privileged access matrix: update sheet, note outstanding approvers (who signed for db-admin?)
- Backup verification: current runbook + last restore test notes (I have runbook draft in repo but no restore logs)
- Change control: link to PRs for last quarter (put PR ids under evidence/changes.txt)
- Vendor contracts: legal redline summary for each vendor (Okta, CloudKMS, Observability vendor)

Notes to self (choppy)
- If Okta export fails, escalate to infra oncall and ask for direct DB dump of admin group mapping.
- Use CLI export: `okta apps list` + `okta users export` (remind Raj about rate limits)
- Collect screenshots with date overlay — use macOS Screenshot -> annotate with timestamp.

Vendor review quick thoughts
- Okta: high priority, need contract clause that allows subprocessor list + SOC2 attestation copy. Check Confluence notes: "Identity vendor mapping".
- Observability: confirm data residency (EU customers). If not documented, file as TODO for private deployment customers.
- Cloud KMS: confirm who has key-admin; add to privileged access doc.

Draft email skeleton to legal (to send after noon sync)
Subject: Quick ask: vendor subprocessors summary + redline requests\Body bullets:
  - Consolidated list of vendors we need security attestations from (Okta, NewRelic, Sentry?)
  - Ask for templated clause to request SOC2 or ISO27001 evidence and subprocessor list
  - Deadline: request responses within 10 business days

Meeting notes (2026-03-14 standup)
- SRE: log retention exports will be available by EOD Wed (has ticket SEC-4334)
- Product: need evidence of data minimization for hosted api (pointed to privacy-policy update)
- Solutions eng: one customer requested on-prem KMS documentation — flag for private-deployments runbook

Open questions / blockers
- Who owns the final sign-off for SOC2 evidence pack? (I think legal + security head)
- Are there any outstanding NDAs preventing sharing vendor SOC reports internally? Check with commercial ops.
- We still need a restore test from Q4 2025 — where are the logs?

Micro-todo (fast wins)
- [ ] Upload log-retention-2026-03-14.tar to evidence repo (path: evidence/logs/)
- [ ] Add a row for Okta in vendor-evidence.csv with status=pending
- [ ] Create minimal one-page memo for legal and attach vendor list
- [ ] Take MFA screenshot for my own account and drop in evidence/screenshots/

Longer term items (not for today)
- Formalize quarterly evidence refresh calendar and owner map (who rotates ownership?)
- Add automated exports for Okta admin group every Monday to S3 (discuss with infra)
- Draft KMS key rotation proof template for Private customers

Random notes / heuristics
- Keep filenames short and predictable: vendor-<name>-evidence-YYYYMMDD.tar.gz
- When in doubt, snapshot config + small README explaining where it came from and who pulled it
- Prefer time-stamped screenshots over “looks like” language in evidence bundle

References/pointers
- Evidence index page (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SOC2+Evidence+Index
- Jira tickets: SEC-4321, SEC-4334 (SRE export), LEG-221 (vendor clause request)
- Repo: git@github.com:redwood-inference/compliance-evidence.git (branch: priya/evidence-2026-03)

End of dump — will tidy and convert to checklist after legal reply.

Mini retrospective: keep this doc short. If I still have loose items by EOD, escalate in #security slack and tag Raj + Eve.

---
local quick commands for exports (notes):
- Okta: `okta users list --filter "status eq \"ACTIVE\"" --output csv > okta-active-2026-03-14.csv`
- GCP logs: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=gae_app" --limit 10000 --format json > logs.json`

Timestamp: 2026-03-15 09:24 PST
